description.value: Chaibaba is a community-focused loose leaf tea shop in downtown Kelowna, operated by Crystal Russell for over a decade. The shop blends and sells globally sourced organic teas and offers an in-store drink menu with hot and cold beverages. It is a calm, intentional stop with sidewalk seating — a nice contrast to the typical cyclist pit stop.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 53m; rack at 80m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at chaibabatea.ca is active and confirms the OSM address (104 - 1289 Ellis Street, Kelowna, BC), phone (1-250-717-5616), and that the business is a community-based loose leaf tea shop with an in-store drink menu. OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are consistent with the tea-focused, organic product line on the website. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities beyond takeaway.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active tea shop with a confirmed physical location in downtown Kelowna; website and OSM are consistent. A welcoming stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Product line is entirely plant-based organic teas

wow_evidence: community-focused loose leaf tea shop in downtown Kelowna, operated by Crystal Russell for over a decade
